faq.a: It depends on your monthly units. A home using about 300 units a month often needs around a 2 to 3 kW system.

faq.q: Will solar work during a power cut?

faq.q: How often should I service my AC?
faq.a: Once or twice a year. Do it before summer, and again if you run the AC almost daily or live near a dusty road.

faq.q: Why is my AC running but not cooling?
faq.a: Common causes are choked filters, low gas or a dirty outdoor coil. A technician check will tell which one it is.

faq.q: Is gas refilling needed every year?
faq.a: No. Gas does not get used up. If it is low, there is a leak that should be repaired.

faq.q: Why is water dripping from my indoor unit?
faq.a: Usually a blocked drain pipe or a dirty coil. We clear the drain and clean the unit.

faq.q: Can you install an AC I bought online?
faq.a: Yes. We install any brand, and you only pay for the fitting and any extra pipe or stand you need.

faq.q: How often should I change RO filters?
faq.a: Sediment and carbon filters about twice a year; the membrane lasts longer, depending on how hard your water is.

faq.q: Why does my RO water taste different?
faq.a: Usually it means filters are exhausted or the tank needs cleaning. A service normally fixes the taste.

faq.q: Is RO water suitable for everyone?
faq.a: RO is good for high TDS and hard water. Where TDS is low, UV or UF can be enough. We test before we advise.

faq.q: Can you service a purifier bought from another brand?
faq.a: Yes. We service most RO, UV and UF models, and can source standard parts for them.

faq.q: Why is my RO wasting so much water?
faq.a: A worn membrane or a faulty valve can increase reject water. We check and fix it.
